messages:
maria: Kicking off EU staggered release prep for 10:00 UTC. Need final freeze window confirm and rollback triggers. :eyes:
alex: We have a freeze from 09:45-11:00 UTC, ops aware. Are we pinning model and runtime versions?
sophie: Yes — plan is runtime 3.1.0 + model v2.3.1 pinned in eu-west-1 canary, then scale. I'll attach release notes in thread.
maria: please paste release notes link
sophie: https://internal.redwood/release/2.3.1 :link: changelog + perf summary. Main risk: memory regression on long-context tests.
jamal: Oncall: rollback criteria are: 1) 5m error rate > 2.5% OR 2) p95 latency > 1200ms sustained for 3m. Also watch token-cost spike > 20% vs baseline.
ops-oncall: Confirming metrics alert runbook: `runbook: rollback-eu` -> page has escalation steps.
alex: Deploy-bot, pin and start staggered canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% every 10m. Command?
deploy-bot: Automated recommendation: `deploy start --tag v2.3.1 --regions eu-west-1 --stages 10,30,100 --interval 10m`
sophie: I'll run smoke suite after 10% passes. Smoke list: `smoke/eu-long-context`, `smoke/e2e-auth`, `smoke/token-burn`
maria: If smoke fails, immediate abort and rollback to v2.3.0. Jamal, please be ready to hit rollback at T+15m.
jamal: Got it. I'll watch the alerts and can run:
```
deploy rollback --tag v2.3.0 --regions eu-west-1
```
ops-oncall: Also setting a temporary routing diversion: `routing set diversion --percent 5 --region us-west-2` as a safety net.
sophie: Starting 10% canary now.
deploy-bot: Pinned v2.3.1 in eu-west-1, canary at 10% started at 10:02 UTC.
alex: :thumbsup: Monitoring dashboard https://dashboards.redwood/boards/rollout-eu (watch p95, errors, token-cost, mem OOMs)
maria: Thanks team. If green at +30m we proceed to 30%. Final sync at +30m. If thresholds hit, abort and rollback per runbook.
